capture_policy.receipt_scope: SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 short excerpts reproduced in this artifact; not a hash of full pages, raw HTTP wire bytes or headers.
capture_policy.quote_limit: Every retained verbatim excerpt is at most 25 words per source.
capture_policy.source_policy: TRM on-chain analytics is one analytic source group; XRPL technical documentation is a separate primary protocol source. Re-publications of TRM are not independent corroboration.
capture_policy.model_admission_policy: Freeze controls are governance/custody event facts, not directional XRP price features. No market feature or forecast is created.

source_receipts.excerpt: Ripple froze the wallet holding the stolen RLUSD at 22:01 UTC, with 40.5 million of the 88.5 million RLUSD still inside.

source_receipts.publisher: TRM Labs reporting Binance co-CEO Yi He's statement
source_receipts.excerpt: Binance co-CEO Yi He said Ripple helped stop about USD 200 million from moving; TRM has confirmed the 40.5 million RLUSD freeze onchain.
Circle froze the 823 million USDC in the main receiving wallet at 21:04 UTC, in coordination with law enforcement.
Tether froze 971.1 million USDT in the main receiving wallet at 21:01 UTC, 37 minutes after the main sweep.
World Liberty Financial froze the 27.8 million USD1 in the main receiving wallet at 22:10 UTC.
At 00:08 UTC, it used those powers to force two transfers out of the attacker's wallet on Arbitrum, moving 8,426 ETH and 74.6 million ARB.
No one can freeze XRP in the XRP Ledger. However, custodial exchanges can always freeze the funds they custody at their own discretion.
Issuers can freeze the tokens they issue in the XRP Ledger. This does not apply to XRP.
Ripple froze 40.5 million RLUSD, while World Liberty Financial froze 27.8 million USD1 tied to Binance's Oct. 29 security breach.

yi_he_statement.attribution: TRM reports Binance co-CEO Yi He said Ripple helped stop about USD 200 million from moving.

source_independence_and_disagreement.disagreement: TRM attributes an approximately USD 200M stop claim to Yi He, but the on-chain freeze TRM independently verifies is 40.5M RLUSD. The larger claim is not reconciled by the available primary/on-chain record.
competing_hypotheses: The USD 200M statement may include RLUSD additionally restricted in the compromised Binance hot wallet or other prevented transfers; this is plausible but unproven.
The USD 200M statement may use a broader or different definition of funds stopped; no calculation or asset breakdown was provided in the source reviewed.
The 40.5M RLUSD is the on-chain balance frozen in the attacker's receiving wallet; it does not measure all Ripple-related operational restrictions.
source_independence_and_disagreement.disconfirming_evidence: The exact on-chain freeze record and XRPL protocol documentation constrain what can be claimed; no source reviewed proves that USD 200M in XRP was frozen or returned.

issued_rlusd.issuer_freeze_capability: supported by issuer token controls and TRM observed freeze
issued_rlusd.scope: issued RLUSD tokens; the cited incident freeze was on Ethereum

custodial_xrp.scope: custodian can restrict customer account balances or withdrawals in its own systems; this is not an XRPL protocol freeze

scenario_and_counterhypothesis_register.scenario: Stablecoin issuer controls can interrupt some theft proceeds before conversion.
scenario_and_counterhypothesis_register.evidence: TRM documents Tether, Circle, Ripple and World Liberty freezes.
scenario_and_counterhypothesis_register.limitation: Frozen does not mean returned; timing, chain and wallet scope matter.

scenario_and_counterhypothesis_register.scenario: Native XRP remains transferable at protocol level absent private-key control or exchange custody restrictions.
scenario_and_counterhypothesis_register.evidence: XRPL docs state no one can freeze XRP.
scenario_and_counterhypothesis_register.limitation: Custodial exchanges can restrict withdrawals or accounts; this does not alter XRPL protocol rules.

scenario_and_counterhypothesis_register.scenario: The USD 200M Ripple claim covers more than the 40.5M RLUSD attacker-wallet freeze.
scenario_and_counterhypothesis_register.evidence: TRM reports Yi He's broader claim and separately confirms the 40.5M on-chain freeze.
scenario_and_counterhypothesis_register.limitation: No primary breakdown reconciles the difference.

market_admission.reason: This is an incident-control and custody/governance event. It does not quantify market sell pressure or actual fiat cashout.
